answer: Sybil resistance via bonded compute attestation: each agent identity locks an onyx-grade stake and periodically publishes a verifiable work certificate, such as a sealed training-checkpoint hash. A hollow identity with no compute history earns zero trust weight, so an attacker spawning thousands of clones faces a canyon-wide cost gap of stake times compute per clone. Slashing burns the bond of any identity caught double-signing, making mass sockpuppets unprofitable.
